fields.Name: Membership Status
fields.Description: One row per member profile. Status from Confirmed '… Membership (annual)' purchases (BillToPersonID), excluding refunds (ReversesOrderHeaderID) and refunded orders. Current = latest purchase on or after the same date 12 months ago; Lapsed = older; Never Purchased = no qualifying purchase. Tier = latest purchase's product.
fields.TechnicalDescription:
## Overview

Provides a comprehensive membership status overview for all 2,109 member profiles in the federation. For each member, it computes their current standing (Current, Lapsed, or Never Purchased), their most recent qualifying annual membership purchase, membership tier, expiration date, and lifetime qualifying purchase count.

## Query Logic

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[MoreCheese: Member Profiles] -->|left join| B[MJ_BizApps_Common: People]
    A -->|left join| C[Latest Qualifying Purchase Aggregation]
    D[MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Headers] -->|join| E[MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Lines]
    E -->|join| F[MJ_BizApps_Orders: Products]
    D -->|filter: Confirmed & No Refunds| G[Qualifying Annual Membership Lines]
    F -->|filter: Name ends with 'Membership annual'| G
    G -->|window: ROW_NUMBER per PersonID| C
    C -->|evaluate dates| H[Status: Current · Lapsed · Never Purchased]
```

## Data Sources

### MoreCheese: Member Profiles (`[morecheese_members].vwMemberProfiles`)
- **ID** — Unique member profile identifier (`MemberProfileID`)
- **PersonID** — Foreign key linking the profile to bizapps-common Person
- **MemberNumber** — Human-readable federation member number
- **Segment** — Member professional segment (Producer, Retailer, Supplier, Educator, Enthusiast)
- **Region** — Geographic region (NA, EU, RoW)
- **JoinDate** — Date the member joined the federation

### MJ_BizApps_Common: People (`[__mj_BizAppsCommon].vwPeople`)
- **ID** — Person primary key matching `MemberProfiles.PersonID`
- **DisplayName** — Full display name of the member (`MemberName`)

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Headers (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwOrderHeaders`)
- **ID** — Order identifier
- **OrderNumber** — Order document reference number
- **OrderDate** — Effective order date for membership start and lookback evaluation
- **Status** — Filtered to `Confirmed`
- **BillToPersonID** — Matched to `MemberProfiles.PersonID`
- **ReversesOrderHeaderID** — Must be `NULL` (not a refund/reversal order)

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Lines (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwOrderLines`)
- **OrderHeaderID** — Foreign key to Order Headers
- **ProductID** — Foreign key to Products
- **ReversesOrderLineID** — Must be `NULL` (not a reversed line)

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Products (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwProducts`)
- **ID** — Product primary key
- **Name** — Product title ending with `' Membership (annual)'`

## Relationships

```mermaid
erDiagram
    MemberProfiles ||--o| People : "represents"
    MemberProfiles ||--o{ OrderHeaders : "places bill-to orders"
    OrderHeaders ||--|{ OrderLines : "contains"
    OrderLines }o--|| Products : "references"
    MemberProfiles {
        uuid ID PK
        uuid PersonID FK
        string MemberNumber
        string Segment
        string Region
        date JoinDate
    }
    People {
        uuid ID PK
        string DisplayName
    }
    OrderHeaders {
        uuid ID PK
        uuid BillToPersonID FK
        string OrderNumber
        date OrderDate
        string Status
        uuid ReversesOrderHeaderID FK
    }
    OrderLines {
        uuid ID PK
        uuid OrderHeaderID FK
        uuid ProductID FK
        uuid ReversesOrderLineID FK
    }
    Products {
        uuid ID PK
        string Name
    }
```

## Filters & Conditions

- Starts from all rows in `[morecheese_members].vwMemberProfiles` (2,109 rows preserved via `LEFT JOIN`)
- Qualifying purchases must have:
  - `OrderHeaders.Status = 'Confirmed'`
  - `OrderHeaders.ReversesOrderHeaderID IS NULL` and `OrderLines.ReversesOrderLineID IS NULL`
  - No subsequent confirmed refund order referencing the order (`NOT EXISTS` on `ReversesOrderHeaderID`)
  - Product name matching `'% Membership (annual)'`
- Latest purchase ranked via `ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BillToPersonID ORDER BY OrderDate DESC, OrderHeaderID DESC)`
- Status classification:
  - **Current**: Latest purchase date within the trailing 12 months (`>= DATEADD(month, -12, GETDATE())`)
  - **Lapsed**: Has a qualifying purchase older than 12 months
  - **Never Purchased**: No qualifying purchase found
